name: LangSketch
tagline: A desktop app for building agent workflows by drag and drop, with model routing and data-platform tools.
problem: Agent frameworks have a steep learning curve that excludes non-developers.
solution: A visual editor for agents and tools with utility functions, provider keys and data-platform credentials, routing calls across models to control cost, packaged for all desktop systems.
demo_moment: Team-described: drag nodes to build an agent and run it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Martian: LLM Routing with Martian” among 261 submissions.
Makes routing a first-class part of agent design.

lessons: A five-person team can ship a cross-platform app if scope is a builder, not a product.
